WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.amount,
    t.type
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_flows AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN ft.amount ELSE -ft.amount END) as net_flow,
    COUNT(*) as num_transactions
  FROM filtered_trans ft
  INNER JOIN account a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY ft.account_id, d.A3
),
total_flow AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow
  FROM account_flows
)
SELECT 
  af.account_id,
  af.region,
  af.net_flow,
  af.num_transactions,
  CAST(af.net_flow AS REAL) / tf.total_net_flow as share
FROM account_flows af
CROSS JOIN total_flow tf
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Number of transactions" refers to the count of PRIJEM and VYDAJ transactions for each account (those contributing to net flow), not the total count of all transactions by type.

alternatives.interpretation: "Number of transactions" means the total count of all transaction types for each account
alternatives.sql:
WITH filtered_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.amount,
    t.type
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_flows_base AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ft.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN ft.amount ELSE -ft.amount END) as net_flow
  FROM filtered_trans ft
  INNER JOIN account a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY ft.account_id, d.A3
),
trans_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as all_trans_count
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_flows AS (
  SELECT 
    afb.account_id,
    afb.region,
    afb.net_flow,
    tc.all_trans_count as num_transactions
  FROM account_flows_base afb
  LEFT JOIN trans_counts tc ON afb.account_id = tc.account_id
),
total_flow AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow
  FROM account_flows
)
SELECT 
  af.account_id,
  af.region,
  af.net_flow,
  af.num_transactions,
  CAST(af.net_flow AS REAL) / tf.total_net_flow as share
FROM account_flows af
CROSS JOIN total_flow tf
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
